title: Pip and the Strange Pie
note: b415 — Phase 5 (School readiness) — new sounds 'ay', 'ou' and 'ie'.

pages.brief: Pip the sparrow tilting his head at an unfamiliar round shape in the grass.
Close view of a round pastry pie with a golden crust, sitting in the grass.
Pip the sparrow tapping the crust gently with his bill.
Pip the sparrow pecking off a small bit of the crust.
Pip the sparrow pausing, surprised by the sweet taste.
Pip the sparrow looking closely at the filling inside the crust.
Pip the sparrow pecking another bit from the pie, looking pleased.
Pip the sparrow standing beside the pie, clearly delighted.
Pip the sparrow perched protectively right next to the pie.
Pip the sparrow asleep beside the last small bit of pie.
